purpose: Remove the remaining continuous-allocation idealization from the 35%-cap equal planned-stop-risk structural comparator.
method: Start from the continuous capped equal-risk target, floor each allocation to the NT$1,000 grid, then assign residual NT$1,000 units one at a time to the eligible name that minimizes squared projected-risk-space distance to the continuous target. Ties break by symbol.
postAllocationQuantization: Apply the same 60/40 tranche split and integer-share flooring at buyHigh for plan-preview comparison.
forbidden: do not call this a live allocator
do not infer economic superiority from lower structural risk
do not use actual outcomes to choose the grid assignment
